findings.scope: Four buffered traces at actual swap return; phase/backing identity, no GPU pixel readback. Original analyzer cadence_30_confirmed_for_observed_segment is an average-rate result with a permissive long-hold threshold; it must not be interpreted as regular frame pacing.
findings.inference: Parity-biased 50ms/16.7ms alternation is consistent with AreaAnimationTimelineClock resetting slotStartTicks to the first rendered observation of each native15FPS slot and flooring the 30FPS phase; this needs a renderer clock fix, not new interpolation.
